description: NASA has shut down an instrument on Voyager 1 to conserve power, extending its mission in interstellar space as it continues to send valuable data back to Earth.
title: NASA Shuts Down Voyager 1 Instrument to Extend Mission Life in Deep Space

description: Vivo Y6t has launched in China as a budget 5G smartphone with a 6,500mAh battery, 120Hz LCD panel, and Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset. It comes in three variants, starting at CNY 1,699 (roughly Rs. 23,300), and supports up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. The phone runs OriginOS 6 based on Android 16 and features a 13-megapixel rear camera and a 5-megapixel front camera. It also includes SGS-certified durability, OTG reverse charging, and standard connectivity features.
title: Vivo Y6t Launched With 6,500mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC: Price, Specifications

description: Ultimately, running games you own on local hardware is the best choice. But if that choice is unaffordable to you right now, GeForce Now is perhaps the next best option. It is seamless and simple. And with Nvidia’s Blackwell RTX architecture powering the service, it flies way higher than the competition. This is the definitive way to stream your PC games off the cloud.
title: Nvidia GeForce Now Review: Cloud Gaming Excellence Comes With Caveats

description: Vivo X300 FE is expected to launch soon in India. As for specifications, the Indian version of the phone is believed to be identical to the global model. The global variant runs on OriginOS 6 based on Android 16; the Indian version is expected to ship with FuntouchOS 16. It could run on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chip and feature a 6,500mAh battery with 90W fast charging support.
title: Vivo X300 FE India Launch Roundup: Expected Price in India, Specifications

description: Oppo Enco Clip 2 and Oppo Watch X3 Mini have launched in China alongside the Find X9 Ultra series. The Enco Clip 2 features an open-ear clip design, dual drivers, Bluetooth 6.1, and up to 40 hours of total battery life. The Watch X3 Mini offers a 1.32-inch AMOLED display, Snapdragon W5 chip, and advanced health tracking features. It supports eSIM, NFC, and delivers up to seven days of battery life in power-saving mode. Both devices will go on sale from April 24.
title: Oppo Enco Clip 2 With Open-Ear Design, Up to 40 Hours Total Battery Life Launched Alongside Oppo Watch X3 Mini
Ai+ Nova 2 Ultra Is Here to Shake Things Up, and the Nova 2 Is Making 5G Affordable for Everyone

description: In a new leak, several images showing off the design of the Motorola Edge 70 Pro+  have surfaced online. The renders show the phone in five shades with a hole-punch display design. On the rear, it has a square-shaped camera unit in the upper-left corner. The overall design looks similar to that of the Motorola Edge 70 Pro.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ Leaked Renders Hint at Design, Five Colour Options

description: The OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra is all set to be launched in China next week. In the days leading up to its launch, the brand has been revealing several key details, including its design and colourway. While official specifications still remain under wraps, the upcoming handset has now been sighted on a benchmarking website. The listing not only sheds light on some of the OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra’s internals, but also confirms its moniker.
title: OnePlus Ace 6 Ultra Geekbench Listing Reveals MediaTek Dimensity 9500 Chip, 16GB RAM

description: Oppo Find X9s Pro has been launched in China as the latest addition to the company's flagship X lineup. The new smartphone will be available for purchase in the country via the company’s online store. The phone is powered by a MediaTek Dimensity chipset. Moreover, the handset is backed by a 7,025mAh battery. On top of this, the new Oppo Find X9s Pro carries a Hasselblad-tuned rear camera system, led by two 200-megapixel shooters. It is offered in Energetic Orange, Free White, Native Titanium, and Riding the Wind (translated from Chinese) colour options.
title: Oppo Find X9s Pro Launched With 200-Megapixel Cameras, 7,025mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: WhatsApp is testing a subscription called WhatsApp Plus that adds optional features without affecting core services like messaging, calls, or encryption. Priced at around EUR 2.49 (roughly Rs. 274) per month, it is currently in limited rollout. The plan includes custom themes, alternate icons, exclusive stickers, expanded chat pinning up to 20 chats, bulk chat settings, and additional sounds. It focuses on personalisation and organisation while keeping the standard experience unchanged for non-subscribers.
title: WhatsApp Plus Subscription: What Is It, Pricing, Features and Benefits

description: The Oppo Find X9 Ultra was launched in China and the global markets on Tuesday. It arrives as the top-of-the-line model in the flagship Find X9 lineup, joining the Find X9 and Find X9 Pro models. The handset is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, coupled with 16GB of RAM. It sports a 2K-resolution display with a 144Hz refresh rate and a Hasselblad-backed quad rear camera unit. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra packs a 7,050mAh silicon-carbon battery with 100W wired fast charging support.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Launched With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC, 200-Megapixel Periscope Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Usually, going for a massive screen means you have to live with some pretty big compromises, but the Xiaomi TV S Mini-LED 75 (2026) actually holds its own. It gets the important stuff right. Whether you’re settling in for a movie, catching a game, or playing on a console, the picture looks great.  It isn't perfect, though. The TV is a reminder that these days, just being "good enough" doesn't cut it anymore. Instead, you actually have to deliver, and Xiaomi has done that here.
title: Xiaomi TV S Mini LED 75 (2026) Review: Bright, Bold, and Hard to Ignore

description: Redmi K90 Max has been launched in China. It came in three colour options with a 6.83-inch display and an 8,550mAh Battery with 100W wired fast charging support. The Redmi K90 Max is equipped with a MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC alongside up to 16GB RAM and up to 1TB storage.
title: Redmi K90 Max Launched With Dimensity 9500 SoC, 8,550mAh Battery and Active Cooling Fan: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo Pad 5 Pro, the latest flagship tablet from the tech firm, has been launched in China. The company also unveiled its new compact Oppo Pad Mini during its April 2026 launch event. Both tablets are set to go on sale in the country via the Oppo China online store. The Oppo Pad 5 Pro is offered in Dawn Gold, Mocha Brown and Monet Purple (translated from Chinese) colour options. Moreover, it will go on sale in  8GB + 256GB, 12GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage options. The tablet features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Oppo Pad 5 Pro Launched With 13,380mAh Battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC Alongside Oppo Pad Mini: Price, Features

description: OCBC has launched a tokenised gold fund with the GOLDX token on Ethereum and Solana, targeting institutional investors. The move reflects growing interest in tokenised real-world assets as banks explore blockchain-based financial products backed by physical assets.
title: OCBC Partners Lion Global Investors and DigiFT to Launch Tokenised Gold Fund With GOLDX Token

description: In August 2011, when Apple was navigating a difficult period after Jobs stepped down due to health reasons, the company looked at the relatively unknown Cook to take the reins — a move that defined Apple’s fortunes for the last 15 years. And now again, with John Ternus, the Cupertino giant might have pulled a similar masterstroke.
title: From Hardware Guru to CEO: Why John Ternus Is the Right Choice for Apple

description: Redmi Buds 8 have been launched in China with features including up to 50dB ANC, an 11mm dynamic driver, and Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity. The earbuds support LHDC, SBC, and AAC codecs, along with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification. They offer dual-device pairing, AI-based call noise reduction, and multiple ANC and transparency modes. The earbuds deliver up to 44 hours of claimed battery life with the case. They also come with an IP54 rating and app support.
title: Redmi Buds 8 Launched With Up to 50dB ANC, Up to 44 Hours Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Vivo Y600 Pro has been listed on multiple websites ahead of its launch in China, including China Telecom, Geekbench, and China’s 3C. The handset was spotted on the China Telecom site with the model number V2561A, revealing colourways, storage options, display size, and camera configuration. The phone has also been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the same model number, revealing that it will be powered by an octa core MediaTek chipset. On top of this, the smartphone has been listed on China’s 3C database with the same model number, hinting that it will offer 80W wired fast charging.
title: Vivo Y600 Pro Listings on Geekbench, Regulatory Databases Reveal Key Specifications, Features

title: Heartbeat Season 2 OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Stream This Medical Drama Online

description: Coinbase has launched crypto-backed USDC loans in the UK, allowing users to borrow against assets like Bitcoin and Ether. The move comes as the FCA seeks feedback on upcoming crypto regulations. The offering reflects growing interest in crypto lending products within regulated markets.
title: Coinbase Rolls Out Crypto-Backed Loans in the UK as FCA Shapes Rules

description: Deezer, a Paris-based music streaming platform, has claimed that 44 percent of the daily uploaded tracks are generated using artificial intelligence (AI). The French independent streaming company has also found that the number of AI-generated songs uploaded to the platform per day has increased from 10,000 to 75,000 in just a little over a year.
title: Deezer Claims 75,000 AI-Generated Songs Are Being Uploaded to the Platform Daily

description: Bitcoin traded near $75,800 on Tuesday, rebounding from recent support levels as institutional buying picked up. While ETF inflows have improved, resistance near $78,000 continues to cap upside. Analysts say macro cues and Federal Reserve signals will be key for the next move.
title: Bitcoin Steadies Around $75,800 as Institutional Buying Supports Recovery

description: The Redmi A7 Pro 4G and Redmi A7 4G were launched in India on Tuesday. The handsets are the latest addition to the brand’s entry-level smartphone lineup in the country, and debut a week after the introduction of the Redmi A7 Pro 5G. Both models are powered by the Unisoc T7250 processor, paired with 64GB of onboard storage. The Redmi A7 Pro 4G and Redmi A7 4G are equipped with a 13-megapixel rear camera.
title: Redmi A7 Pro 4G Launched in India With Unisoc T7250 Chip Alongside Redmi A7 4G: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung is reportedly testing silicon-carbon battery technology for future flagship smartphones, even as the Galaxy S26 Ultra retains a 5,000mAh battery. A new report claims the company is evaluating high-capacity cells up to 20,000mAh using new stacking methods. While the technology allows higher energy density without increasing thickness, current prototypes fall short of durability targets. Samsung is taking a cautious approach due to safety standards, but the Galaxy S27 Ultra could become the first model to adopt the upgrade.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Could Launch With Silicon-Carbon Battery Upgrade: Report

description: Motorola Razr 2026 will be launched in the US soon, the company has revealed. Additionally, the company has revealed the colour options for the handset, while hinting at its design. The teaser also mentions “April 29”, a date on which the tech firm could either launch the foldable or start revealing key details about the handset. This comes shortly after a report highlighted that the Motorola Razr 2026 will be launched in the country on May 21. The pricing, along with RAM and storage configurations of the phone, have also surfaced online in the past.
title: Motorola Razr 2026 Launch Date Teased Alongside Design and Colour Options

description: Redmi Pad 2 SE 4G has been launched in China in two colour options with a 9.7-inch 2K (1,280) LCD display.  It runs on a Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 chipset alongside 6GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. It carries a 7,600mAh battery with 18W fast charging support.  It has an 8-megapixel rear camera and a 5-megapixel selfie shooter.
title: Redmi Pad 2 SE 4G Launched With Snapdragon 6s 4G Gen 2 SoC, 7,600mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Apple on Monday rolled out the iOS 26.5 Beta 3 update for iPhone. While it is not a major update, there are still fixes for several bugs and glitches discovered in previous iterations of the OS. The Cupertino-based tech giant says iOS 26.5 Beta 3 resolves an issue where some wallpapers failed to install or could not be removed from the Wallpaper Gallery. Apart from this, developers will be able to access four new features in the native software framework StoreKit.
title: Apple's iOS 26.5 Beta 3 Update for iPhone Rolls Out With Stability Improvements, Bug Fixes

description: Ubisoft has announced a global reveal showcase for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced. The upcoming remake will be officially revealed on April 23. Black Flag Resynced is the long-rumoured remake of Assassin's Creed 4: Black Flag. Ubisoft has said the game will be a solo pirate adventure.
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Will Be Revealed on April 23, Ubisoft Confirms

description: Poco M8s 5G has been launched in select global markets as the latest addition to the Chinese smartphone maker’s budget M lineup. The handset is slated to go on sale globally via the Xiaomi online store. The new Poco M8s 5G will be available for purchase in Black and White colour options, while being offered in 6GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. Moreover, the Poco M8s 5G is powered by a Snapdragon 6s Gen 3 chipset from Qualcomm, paired with a 7,000mAh battery. The handset supports 33W wired fast charging and 18W wired reverse charging.
title: Poco M8s 5G Launched With 7,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Coding seems to be the flavour of the month for artificial intelligence (AI) companies. Recently, OpenAI increased its focus on its coding platform Codex, and now Google appears to be shifting its focus as well. As per a report, the Mountain View-based tech giant’s DeepMind division has created a specialised team that has been tasked with building AI models focused on coding.
title: Google DeepMind Has Reportedly Assembled an A-Team to Take on Anthropic’s AI Coding Prowess

description: A new leak has revealed a list of iPhone models compatible with iOS 27. As per the leak, the upcoming operating system will only be available on iPhone 12 and newer models. Apple's iPhone 11 Pro Max, iPhone 11 Pro, and iPhone 11 models, which launched in 2019, are absent from the list. These models currently support iOS 26. The alleged compatibility list includes the iPhone 12 lineup, iPhone SE (3rd generation), iPhone 13 series, iPhone 14 series and more.
title: iOS 27 Leak Suggests Four Models Might Not Receive Apple's Next iPhone OS Upgrade

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra is set to launch in China later today. Ahead of the launch, the company has confirmed the key specifications of the phone. The Oppo Find X9 Ultra will come with a 7,050mAh battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a 2K resolution display. The new phone will launch in China and other global markets on April 21, alongside the Oppo Find X9s and the Oppo Find X9s Pro.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Battery, Chipset Details Revealed Ahead of Global Launch

description: iPhone 18 will be launched with various downgrades compared to the iPhone 17, including but not limited to manufacturing process, chipset specifications, and RAM, according to a tipster. Apple is reportedly planning to do this to save costs. Moreover, these downgrades are said to bring the standard iPhone 18 model closer to the rumoured low-cost handset in the series, iPhone 18e. This comes as a report recently highlighted that the company is planning to launch the iPhone 18 at the same price as its predecessor, despite the soaring memory prices.
title: iPhone 18 May Not Arrive With Hardware Upgrades, Could Be Closer to iPhone 18e as Apple Cuts Costs: Reports

description: Vivo has reportedly increased prices of several smartphones in India, with hikes between Rs. 1,000 and Rs. 4,000, as highlighted by tipster Abhishek Yadav. The revised pricing, effective April 21, is reflected on the company’s official website and affects models such as the Vivo T5x, V70 series, and Y-series phones. The move aligns with a broader industry trend, possibly driven by rising component costs. Gadgets 360 has reached out to Vivo for comment, but the company has not yet responded.
title: Vivo Smartphones Get Price Hike in India: Vivo T5x, Vivo V70, Vivo Y31 5G Now Cost Up to Rs. 4,000 More

There’s a new design, a bright display, a new processor, a new primary camera, all backed up by a massive battery upgrade. While it seems like a mid-range all-rounder? How well does it stack up against the new and older devices in this segment?

description: Dyson on Tuesday launched the Dyson Supersonic Travel, a compact version of its flagship hair dryer. It is claimed to have been designed for frequent travellers and is geared towards use cases like gym sessions and short trips. Dyson says it focuses on portability while delivering the company’s signature airflow and heat control performance. The Dyson Supersonic Travel is slimmer, lighter, and more compact than the original Supersonic hair dryer and offers attachment compatibility.
title: Dyson Supersonic Travel Hair Dryer Launched With Compact Design, Heat Control Features: Price, Specifications

description: Apple veteran Tim Cook will step down from his position as CEO, the company announced on Monday. The leadership transition, which is set to take place later this year, will see Cook hand over the reins to a senior executive within the company. The move, which the Cupertino-based tech giant claims was approved unanimously by the Board of Directors, marks one of the most significant leadership changes at Apple since Cook took over the position after the passing of Apple co-founder Steve Jobs in 2011.
title: Apple Announces Historic Leadership Transition as Tim Cook Steps Down; John Ternus Named Successor
